title: Managed Deep Agents Integrates Browser Control for Navigation of Non-API Websites
summary:
The Managed Deep Agents (MDA) platform updated its capabilities to allow AI agents to interact directly with web pages by clicking, scrolling, and filling out forms. This integration allows agents to operate on websites that lack native APIs, expanding the range of online services they can navigate independently.

Released in version 0.10 and developed using Stagehand, the update includes async subagents and support for user-scoped sessions. To enhance security, the tool can hand control of the browser session to a human user for authentication, preventing passwords from being passed through the AI model before resuming the task.
